/usr/src/mxe/usr/x86_64-pc-linux-gnu/bin/cmake -E rm -f CMakeFiles/hello.dir/objects.a
/usr/src/mxe/usr/bin/x86_64-w64-mingw32.static-ar qc CMakeFiles/hello.dir/objects.a @CMakeFiles/hello.dir/objects1.rsp
/usr/src/mxe/usr/bin/x86_64-w64-mingw32.static-gcc -O3 -DNDEBUG -Wl,--whole-archive CMakeFiles/hello.dir/objects.a -Wl,--no-whole-archive -o hello.exe -Wl,--out-implib,libhello.dll.a -Wl,--major-image-version,0,--minor-image-version,0 @CMakeFiles/hello.dir/linkLibs.rsp
